input.quote: iii. Licensor hereby, subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement and provided that Licensee makes payments to Licensor as required under this Agreement, grants to Licensee a non-exclusive license to utilize Licensed Technology solely in the Field of Use and subject to the additional restrictions set forth below and otherwise in this License Agreement.
input.rationale: The Article II grant runs only to Licensee, with no coverage for Affiliates or contractors; indeed Article II(II)(c) and (e) confine use and access to "employees of the Licensee" and bar assignment or transfer, and Article IV lets Licensor terminate immediately "[u]pon any breach by Licensee of any representation, warranty, covenant and/or obligation" with no materiality threshold or cure period, making the licence effectively revocable at Licensor's discretion. This falls short of the playbook preferred position (affiliates and contractors covered, termination only for uncured material breach, transferable to successors). The redline amends the grant paragraph to add Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf (with our continuing responsibility for their compliance), confirm successor transferability, and limit termination to a material breach uncured after 30 days' notice, overriding the conflicting restrictions.

proposal.summary: Extend grant to Licensee's Affiliates and contractors, make it non-revocable at will (uncured material breach only) and transferable to a successor.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the grant to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf (we remain responsible for their compliance), confirmed the licence is transferable to a successor in an M&A transaction, and provided that Licensor may terminate only for a material breach we fail to cure within 30 days rather than revoking at will. Our playbook requires a licence that covers affiliates and contractors and is not revocable at the Licensor's discretion; if helpful, we can accept Affiliate coverage on written notice as a fallback.

ops.newText: grants to Licensee, its Affiliates and its contractors acting on Licensee's behalf a non-exclusive license to utilize Licensed Technology solely in the Field of Use and subject to the additional restrictions set forth below and otherwise in this License Agreement. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement, (a) references to employees of the Licensee include employees and personnel of Licensee's Affiliates and of contractors acting on Licensee's behalf, and Licensee shall remain responsible for their compliance with this Agreement; (b) this license is transferable to a successor to Licensee's business by merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets; and (c) this license is not revocable at Licensor's discretion, and Licensor may terminate this Agreement and the license granted hereunder only for a material breach by Licensee that remains uncured thirty (30) days after Licensor's written notice thereof.
